sources.title: LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B-Base · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LFM2.5 is a new family of hybrid models designed for on-device deployment. LFM2.5-24B-A2B is the largest model in the family: a 24B-parameter mixture of experts with only 2B active parameters. It builds on LFM2-24B-A2B with a 131K context window, a vocabulary doubled to 128K tokens, and pre-training scaled up from ~17T to ~33T tokens.
